text:
sam: Quick alert — new quantized reranker (v9-int8) on the clinical+web holdouts: NDCG nearly flat, MRR down ~2.4%. I computed an extra metric I call 'swap_rate' = fraction of queries where top-1 flips between float and int8. It's 6.1% on clinical.

kai: Interesting. Can you share the small CSV and a few disagree examples?

sam: s3://bench/rerank/3790011222/summary.csv
```
model,cohort,ndcg,mrr,top1,swap_rate
float32,clinical,0.639,0.512,0.56,1.9%
int8,clinical,0.637,0.500,0.49,6.1%
float32,web,0.616,0.508,0.52,2.0%
int8,web,0.615,0.506,0.52,2.4%
```

nora: Swap_rate spike on clinical short-queries suggests either tokenization/normalization drift or scorer noise amplified by low-signal docs. Did the canary use identical eval configs?

sam: Harness flags match. I ran tokenizer-parity on 5k clinical queries: token diffs ~0.6% concentrated on greek letters, en-dash and NBSPs. Also ran per-query score-delta histogram — many flips have score gaps <0.01.

kai: Two fast ablations: (A) int8 forcing float tokenizer, (B) int8 with mixed-float last-linear. If A drops swap_rate near baseline, it's tokenizer. If B helps, last-layer quantization matters. Also run bootstrap CI on MRR for clinical slice.

sam: Kicked A/B on a 8k clinical subset. Jobs: 3790011233 (A), 3790011244 (B). eval-bot: started bootstrap CI (1000 resamples).

eval-bot: Abortion not detected; jobs queued.

nora: Also please add a micro-slice for "title-like short queries" (len<=5 & contains colon or parentheses) to the canary dashboard — these are fragile.

sam: Early ablation results: A (int8 + float-tokenizer) reduces swap_rate from 6.1% to 2.2% and recovers ~1.4% MRR. B (mixed-last) recovers ~0.7% MRR and swap_rate ~4.0%. Bootstrap CI: float MRR 0.511 (95% CI [0.503,0.519]), int8 0.500 (95% CI [0.492,0.508]).

kai: So primary issue is tokenization parity. Action: revert any tokenizer mapping diffs in quant branch and add a CI guard that fails if tokenizer hashes differ between float and canary runs. Keep mixed-last-layer as fallback per-cohort mitigation.

nora: I'll file a small GT ticket and update the reranker-onboard checklist: [tokenizer-parity, swap_rate monitor, bootstrap CI for small slices].

sam: Thanks. I'll re-run full canary after the revert and drop per-query disagreement dumps for review.
